name: B10-0364/2025 (S&D) – Governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position ahead of a United Nations review. It asks the UN General Assembly to renew the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum permanently and to give it more resources. It also asks EU countries and EU bodies to keep supporting the forum and to push for a good outcome in the UN vote by the end of 2025.

- The forum's mandate expires on 31 December 2025; the Parliament wants it renewed permanently.
- It affects the UN, EU governments, EU bodies and everyone who uses the internet.
- Next: the UN General Assembly reviews the mandate in autumn 2025.
